title: Why members stay
content:
Members tell us they stay because the cooperative feels personal. They know the staff, fees are easy to understand, and problems get solved in one visit.

Digital services must keep that feeling instead of replacing it.

title: Branch vs. app
left: Best for advice, complex loans and new members who want to meet someone in person.
right: Best for balances, transfers, small loans and anything members do more than once a month.
